akt_vocabulary.note: The vocabulary ids are simulator ids (PHY_*/CHE_*/MAT_*), never canonical ids. 'matched' rows are the only ids safe to carry into learner-state records, and only together with an explicit mapping; unmapped/ambiguous rows must stay unresolved until a curriculum editor decides.

id_policy.historical_ids_resolve_via: graph.id_map (merged_into / replaced_by forward; removed resolves to nothing)

traversal_policy.edge_convention: A --prerequisite_of--> B means A is a prerequisite of B

claims.disclaimer: This report is a mechanical id/field/edge audit of the supplied inputs. It is not expert review of the curriculum and makes no accuracy claim about either model.

notes: Person 2 keeps aliases, topic_path, class_levels, review_status, curriculum_id, curriculum_version, stable_key and audit inside the contract's open 'metadata' object; the record itself stays contract-valid (see docs/curriculum/CONTRACT_REVIEW.md).
Person 3's ConceptNode has a 'topic_group' field that is not in the contract; the canonical equivalents are chapter_id and metadata.topic_path. No contract expansion is proposed here.

prerequisite_edges.note: A contradicted edge means the simulator asserts a prerequisite the canonical curriculum does not accept. The simulator is illustrative data; the canonical graph is the source of truth.
